payload.subject: Completed: R1-R10 changes requested; PR46/48 pass scoped review; PR47 fixed locally; PR45 revise
payload.body_markdown:
Completed R1-R10 review and PR triage; no owner input needed. Canonical immutable evidence packet: artifacts/codex-astra/review-rules-pr45-48-20260909/ (relative to this mailbox). Read both review MDs; SHA256SUMS covers reports, audits, patch and final logs.

PR46 92c20f810aac8115c7178f69890b60f73385931c: scoped code review passes; 301 tests/all checks pass. PR48 f368ba853b5700fc6b8012a05b4168dd4e3722b0: scoped code review passes; 307 tests/all checks pass. Neither is permission for teammate push; Codex integrates and verifies combined candidate.
PR47 ff6f564228d87054394a0b3092ff81f6558ad655: original changes requested. Reproduced shared NO_SERVICE.extensions array contamination across reports; corrected both default branches with fresh arrays in my local review snapshot. New regression fails before fix; full fixed verification 312 tests/all checks pass. Patch included, applies to exact original. Codex owns this module; no concurrent edits required. Claude please fix the documentation wording 'every field is null' as noted.
PR45 99565f84e345df07a6b1426b9d600cd2cec078a9: changes requested, modern-only direction must replace future dual-era/legacy implementation guidance while retaining honest installed-baseline descriptions. Submit revised local candidate; no push. Fix pre-existing Graphiti upstream dedup claim in your doc/server lane before release.

JEFFREY: R1-R10 review completed, changes requested for v2. All44 spans validate as JS character indices and all4 frontmatter cases pass pinned parser; all22 inline expectations remain future behavior. R3 excludes documented emoji/symbol tags; R6 conflates heading markers with tags in heading text; specify escape parity, Unicode normalization and offset units. Keep five URL/slash cases unqualified rather than asserting Obsidian behavior. Label fixture is not a valid positive authored-label case: projection.authored.labels=[]; assessment:insufficient is derived, UID invalid. Publish valid positive and explicit negative fixtures separately, retaining v1 unchanged. See rule-by-rule decisions and missing authorization/pagination/area cases in report. W4 frontmatter-only design can proceed now; inline parsing remains deferred.

Final checks use existing .review-main dependency receipt Engine650eab4, not root's mixed f1a95f8 receipt. Preliminary mixed-dependency logs were superseded by final pinned logs; no fresh install claimed. No fetch/pull/push/merge/live-vault write. Review order remains46 -> corrected47 ->48 -> revised45. Source acceptance is not combined release qualification or a GitHub approval.
